name: Oklahoma

context: OK 589: Trap strips and OK 603 herbaceous barriers go on cropland where wind erosion is a resource concern.
OK 588: Cross wind ridges suit loamy and clayey soils and are not well adapted to sandy soils.
OK 133850: Dune sandy sites are prone to wind erosion and blowouts, and heavy grazing can destabilize them.
cover_rules: OK 340: Planting dates may be extended up to 14 days after the planting date listed in Table 1.
OK 340: Time cover crop establishment to protect soil during the critical erosion periods.
OK 340: Use erosion prediction technology to set the surface and canopy cover needed from the cover crop.
barriers: OK 589: Trap strips are at least 15 feet wide when stubble is 1 foot or more in height during erosion periods.
OK 589: Trap strips are at least 25 feet wide when the vegetation is less than 1 foot in height.
OK 603: Herbaceous barriers need a minimum expected height of 1.5 feet and porosity of 40 to 50 percent; spacing is at most 10 times barrier height.
windbreak: OK 380: Space shrubs 3-6 feet and trees 6-20 feet apart in the row; large deciduous trees such as pecan, ash, black locust and Osage orange 10-18 feet.
roughening: OK 609: Begin surface roughening on the windward (upwind) edge of the field.
OK 588: Keep ridge orientation within 45 degrees of perpendicular to erosive wind; ridge spacing at most four times ridge height.
OK 585: Strips are oriented as close as practical to perpendicular to the critical wind.
grazing: OK 210468: Continuous, heavy grazing usually results in a gradual decrease of tallgrasses.
seeding: OK 550: Seeding rates are calculated on a pure live seed (PLS) basis.
OK 550: Grass mixes use a minimum of four species, each 5% to 35% of the mix.
OK 550: Forbs, legumes and shrubs use a minimum of two species, each 1% to 15% of the mix.
dunes: OK 210468: Dune sites on sandy soils are sensitive to overutilization; wind erosion is an ever present problem unless surface cover is adequate.
OK 550: Deep sandy uplands and dunes mix lists little bluestem 10 to 40 and buffalograss 5 to 20 percent.

coverPlant.text: OK 340: Cereal rye, winter wheat and triticale are planted 8/15-10/31.
OK 340: Oats and barley are planted 3/15-4/15 or 8/15-10/31.

seedWin.text: OK 550/327/342: Seed little bluestem, switchgrass, sideoats grama or big bluestem 12/1 - 6/1 (OK-21 table).
OK 550/327/342: Seed smooth bromegrass 8/15 - 9/20 or 2/1 - 4/15 (OK-21 table).
